_doc: The program defaults stay the remote host's (sudo -n docker, jobs 3, MemAvailable gate 16 GiB,
per-container limit 16 GiB, brake 6 GiB, docker user 1000:1000, disk gate 8 GiB on the project root).
A profile replaces a default only when that flag is absent from the command line.
docker_user "host" is the uid:gid of the process running run_matrix.py.
extra_disk entries are additional launch gates PATH=GiB (the root filesystem of this machine, not the SSD).
local-dev: development set. Grass01 T-arm peak RSS is about 8 GiB, so two replays fit when MemAvailable
stays ahead of the next container. The limit is 10 GiB (the measured peak plus headroom, so a legitimate
run is not killed by its cgroup). The brake at 2.5 GiB is the backstop if two replays ramp together on a
tighter machine. Z-Rough-Road01 is longer than Grass01; its peak was not re-measured here — if a run dies
at the cgroup limit, drop to --jobs 1 or raise --mem-limit-gb after reading peak_rss_gib.
local-eval: evaluation set, Varying-illu03 peak 20.45 GiB. One replay, limit 22 GiB, launch only while
MemAvailable is at least 21.5 GiB, brake at 1 GiB so the legitimate peak (which leaves little free) is not
treated as a runaway. This is close to a 30.5 GiB machine; do not start it while another multi-GiB job is up.
